startTime.description:
The date from which this schedule is effective

If null, it is effective from the time of creation

endTime.description:
The date till which this schedule is effective

If null, it is effective till end of time

cronExpression.description:
The schedule expression -- if null, the job will be triggered once

Syntax for cron expressions -- [Quartz Tutorials - Lesson 6: CronTrigger](http://www.quartz-scheduler.org/documentation/quartz-2.3.0/tutorials/tutorial-lesson-06.html)

skipOverdue.description:
Only relevant when {@link CronJob.concurrent} is false.  If true, then upon completion of a job, the next trigger
time will be based on the current time.  If false, it will be based on the completed job's scheduled time.
